subject: Containment summary + IR artifacts onboarding request
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Containment summary + IR artifacts onboarding request

Hi Sophie —

Quick update following the anomalous authentication activity you reported this morning. Our team detected an unusual spike in token refresh attempts against a single tenant API key (tenant: acme-prod) at ~07:02 UTC. We successfully contained the activity by revoking the implicated API key and rotating service credentials; no customer data exfiltration has been identified in initial telemetry.

What we're sharing now:
- Containment timeline (attached) with the sequence of actions and timestamps
- Initial sanitized snapshot of telemetry (attached) — includes obfuscated identifiers

Action items for you: please confirm the secure transfer destination you'd like us to use (your ShareFile link or an S3 bucket with presigned URL). Also confirm the retention window Acme requires for SOC 2 evidence (e.g. 90 / 180 / 365 days).

We will prepare a short post-incident summary and a scoped artefact package mapped to SIG/CAIQ controls you requested; expect the initial package within 72 hours and the full postmortem in 7 business days.

Attachments: [Attachment: containment-timeline-20250719.csv (CSV, 12KB)], [Attachment: initial-snapshot-20250719.tar.gz (tar.gz, 2.1MB)]

Thanks — apologies for the disruption.

Jasmine Liu
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Sophie Trent <sophie@acmeinc.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-19T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Containment summary + IR artifacts onboarding request

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the quick note.

A few quick clarifications before we start the transfer:
1) Scope: please confirm whether the artifacts will include per-tenant request logs vs. platform-level telemetry. We need per-tenant logs for our SOC 2 evidence.
2) Retention: Acme's policy is 1 year retention for incident evidence. Will you be able to set a 365-day expiry on the delivery link?
3) Encryption / access controls: we prefer a ShareFile delivery (Acme ShareFile folder is fine) and would like the files encrypted at rest with audit logging on access.
4) Legal point of contact: please also copy our legal POC (legal@acmeinc.com) if anything in the artifacts touches personally identifiable information.

Can you also map which SIG/CAIQ controls the upcoming evidence package will cover? That will speed our internal review.

—Sophie
Sophie Trent
Senior Security Program Manager, Acme, Inc.
security@acmeinc.com

On Sun, Jul 19, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick update following the anomalous authentication activity you reported this morning. Our team detected an unusual spike...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie@acmeinc.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-20T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Containment summary + IR artifacts onboarding request

Sophie — thanks for the clarifying questions. Short answers up front, details below.

1) Scope: we'll provide per-tenant request logs (request metadata + obfuscated identifiers) for acme-prod, plus platform telemetry slices that show the anomaly context.
2) Retention: we will upload to your ShareFile folder and mark the objects with a 365-day lifecycle where supported; if ShareFile does not support expiry we will provide presigned S3 links with explicit expiration and a retention contract note.
3) Encryption / access: files will be encrypted at rest in our storage; transfer will use TLS and we will enable object-level audit logs on the transfer link.
4) Legal: noted — we will CC legal@acmeinc.com on the delivery notification and redact any PII before transfer.

Planned deliverables and timeline:
- Within 24 hours: scoped evidence index (evidence-index-20250719.csv) and IR runbook extract (ir-runbook-v2.pdf) mapping artifacts to SIG/CAIQ controls.
- Within 72 hours: full artifact package (redacted logs, sanitized telemetry samples, containment timeline).
- Within 7 business days: full postmortem (postmortem-20250719-redacted.pdf) including root cause analysis and mitigations.

Transfer plan: we can upload to the ShareFile link you provide (preferred) or generate expiring S3 presigned URLs. Please confirm which you prefer and provide the target path. If you want, we can start with a single sample payload to validate access prior to the full upload.

Attachments: [Attachment: ir-runbook-v2.pdf (PDF, 145KB)], [Attachment: evidence-index-20250719.csv (CSV, 4KB)]

Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Trent <sophie@acmeinc.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-07-22T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Containment summary + IR artifacts onboarding request

Sophie —

We uploaded the initial artifact package to the ShareFile folder you confirmed (link below) and redacted PII per your request. Package contents:
- postmortem-20250719-redacted.pdf (full narrative, RCA, mitigations)
- redacted-telemetry-sample.json (example records used in analysis)
- containment-timeline-20250719.csv
- initial-snapshot-20250719.tar.gz (sanitized snapshot)
- evidence-index-20250719.csv (mapping to SIG/CAIQ and SOC 2 CC controls)

Access details: files are encrypted at rest, transfer over TLS. ShareFile folder has object-level audit enabled; we set a 365-day retention flag on the objects and will not delete before that period without Acme's written approval.

Download link (Acme ShareFile): https://acme.sharefile.com/s/secure-folder-placeholder
JIRA: INFRA-4871 (internal tracking)
HubSpot record: hs_123456789

If you want a live walkthrough of the package and the SIG/CAIQ mapping, Marissa and I can run a 30-minute session early next week. Please let us know a preferred time and include anyone from legal if needed.

Attachments: [Attachment: postmortem-20250719-redacted.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [Attachment: redacted-telemetry-sample.json (JSON, 18KB)]

Best,

Jasmine Liu
